Subject: Great call — let's lock a session with infra + ops

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the call today — that was super helpful for us to understand Redwood's serving approach. Jordan and I want to get the right folks on a deeper technical session focused on throughput/latency, autoscaling behavior for burst traffic, and integration with our identity/KMS setup.

Can you propose a 60–90min window next week? Our preferred times are:
- Tue 9/7 morning PT (09:00–11:00)
- Wed 9/8 early afternoon PT (13:00–15:00)
- Thu 9/9 any time after 11:00 PT

Also would like to see a short agenda so we can pull our infra and security leads.

Thanks,
Alex

alex.turner@brightmetrics.com | +1 415-555-0199

Subject: Re: Great call — let's lock a session with infra + ops

Hi Alex — great to hear back. Glad the discovery was useful.

Short recap and proposal:
- Goal: 60–90 minute technical deep dive to validate performance, failover, and security posture for a production rollout.
- Redwood attendees (proposed): Ben Carter (ML infra lead), Neha Kapoor (Solutions / security liaison), myself for product context.
- Your attendees: please bring your infra/ops + security leads (Jordan noted he will loop them in).

Proposed slots (we can extend to 90m if you'd like):
1) Tue 9/7 09:30–10:45 PT (75m)
2) Wed 9/8 13:00–14:00 PT (60m)
3) Thu 9/9 11:30–13:00 PT (90m)

Draft agenda (we'll refine after you confirm the roster):
- 0–10m: quick intros and objectives
- 10–35m: architecture walkthrough (serving runtime, routing, KV/prefix caching)
- 35–55m: performance & latency SLOs + live demo of a burst scenario
- 55–70m: security/compliance touchpoints (KMS, audit logs, data handling)
- 70–75m: Q&A and next steps / mutual action plan

I've attached a short mutual action plan (MAP_BrightMetrics_Q3.pdf) that outlines what we typically cover and required artifacts. If any of the slots above don't work, tell me your top two and we'll pivot.

Best,
Marissa

Marissa Cole
